SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO, KEY_2 AS QUOTATION_SEQ FROM ICOMTRXL C WHERE DOC_NAME = 'REDOWN' AND KEY_10 in ('N','A') AND TARGET IN ('KRCHAN0058','KRCHAN0059','KRCHAN0060','KRDONG0708')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.KEY_1 AS PLANT, A.KEY_5 AS QUOTATION_NO, '1' AS QUOTATION_SEQ, A.KEY_4 AS REVISION_NO, A.KEY_5 AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, TO_NUMBER(A.KEY_6) AS UNIT_PRICE01, A.KEY_7 AS REMARK, f_split(key_8,'^',1) AS IF_DATE, f_split(key_8,'^',2) AS IF_TIME FROM ICOMTRXL A WHERE A.DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND A.TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND A.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND A.KEY_10 in ('A','N')
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'Y', KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND KEY_10 in ('A','N')
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'E', KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND KEY_10 in ('A','N')
